name: lightweight_afc_ci_benchmark
description: Small deterministic AFC validation case for CI and regression tests. This is not a CFD validation dataset.
checks: 2D surrogate errors are computable on canonical data
3D CL increases reasonably with C_mu and CD/CM are continuous
A small Opti problem with AFC variables converges
external_validation_data_policy: Large CFD/RANS/experimental datasets should be stored outside this repository and passed to the validation report script by path.
